description: ADVERTISEMENT CONSENT FOR THE INSTALLATION OF 6 X FASCIA SIGNS, 2 X HOARDING SIGNS AND 1 X INTERNALLY ILLUMINATED TOTEM SIGN.
decision_conditions:
